name: Closing Methods
excerpt: Closing Methods describe how projects are concluded, including integration, addition, extinction, and starvation.
notes: Closing Methods in project management include Integration, where the project is successfully completed and integrated into operations; Addition, where a new unit is added to the company; Extinction, where the project is completed with no further additions; and Starvation, where the project ends due to lack of funding. These methods are crucial for formal project closure.
context_summary: - Include Integration, Addition, Extinction, and Starvation.
- Addition adds a new unit to the company.
- Extinction ends the project with no further additions.
- Starvation ends the project due to lack of funding.
